# Synthwave Roleplay

Synthwave Roleplay is an immersive roleplaying server and community. We are moving toward endless possibilities, providing a vibrant community for players to craft, share, and roleplay in a city built by imagination.

## Core Links
- Discord: https://discord.gg/ygSGMfBFeS
- Rules: https://synthwave.in/rules
- Privacy Policy: https://synthwave.in/privacy
- Queue/Priority: https://synthwave.in/queue

## Getting Started
Join our Discord server to begin your adventure and whitelist for the server. Connect via FiveM to join the city!
